title: VisualPlan
description: Output from the Art Director Agent. A per-story art-direction document that drives the Remotion compositional engine. Unlike the legacy ScenePlan (which only picked one of six fixed templates), a VisualPlan authors the palette, the illustration style contract, and a per-beat shot list of composable layers, so every video is structurally unique.

concept.description: One-sentence visual concept for this story. The through-line every shot serves.

palette.description: Brand-anchored palette. Ground and ink stay near-constant for channel identity; accent carries story meaning.

ground.description: Paper background. Defaults to the brand paper white.

ink.description: Primary linework and typography colour. Defaults to brand near-black.

accent.description: The single semantic accent for this story.

accent_role.description: Why this accent was chosen. verified=confirmed/positive (green), alert=failure/risk (red), neutral=colour is not meaningful (mono), topic=the subject owns a hue.

accent_rationale.description: Why the director chose this accent for this story.

illustration_style.description: The style contract appended to every illustration prompt in this video. Load-bearing for visual coherence across shots.

motion_language.description: Governs spring stiffness, stagger cadence, and transition character across the whole video.

shots.description: Ordered shot list. One shot per narration unit, including the hook and the outro.

beat_name.description: The narration unit this shot renders: '__hook__', '__outro__', or a scriptwriter beat name.

layout.description: Which composition to build from the layer library.

headline.description: Short on-screen text. Not a full sentence. Never the whole narration.

kicker.description: Optional small eyebrow label above the headline. Director-authored, never hardcoded.

emphasis_words.description: Words inside the headline to render in the accent colour.

text_anchor.description: Where the text block sits, so it never collides with the illustration.

illustration.description: Present when this shot should carry a generated illustration.

prompt.description: SUBJECT and COMPOSITION for this shot. The style contract is appended automatically. Must describe a concrete visual metaphor, never text.

priority.description: 1 is highest. Used to spend a limited illustration budget on the shots that earn it.

motion.description: Camera treatment applied to the illustration plate.

data.description: Present for data_readout layouts. Figures must come verbatim from the narration.

value.description: The figure exactly as spoken, e.g. '84,000'.

nodes.description: Present for node_flow and compare_two_up. Director-authored labels, never a word-count split of the narration.

annotations.description: Optional callout notes drawn with a leader line over the illustration.

transition_in.description: How this shot enters from the previous one.
